sources.entry: Burrow - Free, open-source native app for the Mole cleaner: clean caches, uninstall apps and the leftovers of deleted ones, map the disk and watch system health, all through Mole's safety checks. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/khan-umirzakoff/Mole-GUI) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Burrow is a free, open-source native SwiftUI Mac app that wraps the Mole command-line cleaner, providing a graphical interface for cleaning caches, uninstalling apps, mapping disk usage and monitoring system health.
keywords: free up disk space on mac
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac
uninstall apps and their leftover files
find large folders and files on disk
clean old installer files and build folders
monitor Mac health, CPU, memory and battery
review cleanup with a dry-run preview before deleting
how_to_run: Open the DMG and drag Burrow to Applications
notable: Runs Mole's own engine and safety checks; deletes go through Mole or to the Trash
Leftover scanner finds caches, logs and settings of apps already deleted, and offers cleanup when an app is removed
Disk Map treemap with drill-down, reveal in Finder and move to Trash
Results persist between launches; background re-scan of stale pages
Free and open source under GPL-3.0, with no account, ads or telemetry
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon
Ad-hoc signed, not notarized, so macOS Gatekeeper requires manual approval on first open
Community project, not affiliated with Mole or tw93
